Title: 2022-05-11 Hotfix Patch
Subtitle: Hotfix
CleanedNotes:
=== General ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed a few tooltip descriptions in Italian language.
  • Fixed the description for the 6 Year Anniversary Spray.
  • The 6.5 Year Banner is now properly awarded along with other 6 Year Anniversary rewards.
  • The Battle Ready Li-Ming Spray is now properly functioning in game when equipped in a Hero's loadout.
  • Fixed an issue where the Classic 2021 Emoji Pack is not showing properly.

=== Heroes: Hanzo ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Hanzo's Scatter Shot now ricochets as intended from all sides in Alterac Pass.

=== Heroes: Rehgar ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Desert Adept Shaman Rehgar Skin now properly shows in game.

=== Heroes: Sylvanas ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Sylvanas's Wailing Arrow with Deafening Blast is now effective as the graphical indicator radius shows.
  • Sylvanas's Overwhelming Affliction is now properly applied to a secondary target getting 3 stacks from the Withering Fire applying stacks from Remorseless.
